title: Unified Data Management Services; Stage 3 (UDM SBI)
tagline: UDM — subscriber data that informs session and policy context
summary: TS 29.503 defines the Nudm services on the UDM. In the 29.512 PDU session journey, UDM is indirect: PCF may use subscriber and session-management subscription data when evaluating SmPolicyDecision. SMF does not call UDM for CreateSMPolicy — but session policy can depend on what UDM holds about the UE's subscriptions.
defines: Nudm_SDM — Subscriber Data Management (session management subscription data)
Subscriber data models referenced across the core
whyItMatters: Session policy is not only slice and DNN — it can reflect subscriber-specific session management subscription data. Understanding 29.503 explains where that context lives before PCF reads policy rules from UDR (29.504/29.519) during step 5 of the establishment flow.
